name: Tordesilos (Spain)
description: White field with a green band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tordesilos (a tower on a green mount on yellow).
history: Tordesilos adopted its arms and flag officially on 30 July 2004; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, white, crossed diagonally by a green band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, with the municipal arms in its colours superimposed at the centre.
